option_label: Use only high-confidence Treasury/cash weights with bank cash 0.70
professional_rationale: Most conservative treatment of bank custody risk and stress exposure
implementation_consequence: Lowers RQI for cash-heavy reserve periods and may reduce usable sample comparability
user_action_needed: Choose if prioritizing defensibility over continuity

option_label: Keep pilot weights and add bank cash robustness at 0.70 and 0.90
professional_rationale: Balances theoretical interpretability with continuity of current pipeline
implementation_consequence: Freeze current weights as v1 but require sensitivity tables before claims
residual_risk: Primary estimates still depend on unverified assumptions
user_action_needed: Approve or revise as primary v1 rule

option_label: Raise bank cash to 0.90 in primary RQI
professional_rationale: Treats regulated cash as nearly Treasury-like
implementation_consequence: Lifts RQI for bank-cash-heavy periods
residual_risk: Weakens ability to test banking-stress mechanism
user_action_needed: Choose only with strong theoretical justification

option_label: Exclude early-2022 reports from all analysis
professional_rationale: Maximizes comparability across detailed reserve reports
implementation_consequence: Reduces early sample and removes timing evidence
residual_risk: May throw away valid disclosure timing information

option_label: Keep for DII/timing but exclude from RQI interpretation
professional_rationale: Uses valid disclosure timing while avoiding false reserve-quality precision
implementation_consequence: Preserves event-study timing and DII but keeps RQI missing

option_label: Impute RQI from later composition
professional_rationale: Would improve balance but creates unsupported precision
implementation_consequence: Increases sample size artificially
residual_risk: High risk of biased and non-auditable RQI
user_action_needed: Reject unless external composition evidence is found

option_label: Manually reconcile reserve table and code adjusted RQI
professional_rationale: Could preserve important stress-period RQI observation
implementation_consequence: Requires visual accounting review and documented adjustment
user_action_needed: Choose if willing to audit PDF table line by line

option_label: Keep DII/event timing but leave RQI missing
professional_rationale: Avoids mechanically invalid component total
implementation_consequence: Protects RQI integrity while retaining disclosure event
user_action_needed: Approve as v1 unless manual reconciliation is completed

option_label: Use automated RQI despite component mismatch
professional_rationale: Would retain row but violates accounting consistency
implementation_consequence: Could contaminate stress-period coefficient

option_label: Freeze auditor coding from OCR text
professional_rationale: Fast but evidentiary basis is weak
implementation_consequence: Removes manual flag prematurely

option_label: Keep provisional until visual or official verification
professional_rationale: Matches academic source-control standards
implementation_consequence: Maintains manual_review flag for affected rows

option_label: Use issuer-level transparency page as sufficient source
professional_rationale: May be acceptable if official page identifies provider clearly
implementation_consequence: Can resolve many rows faster than PDF visual review
user_action_needed: Choose if official page is archived with access date

option_label: Fold weekly disclosures into monthly DII
professional_rationale: Convenient but blends different disclosure types
implementation_consequence: Inflates monthly DII without event-level support

option_label: Treat weekly disclosures as separate events
professional_rationale: Preserves event-level disclosure design and frequency distinction
implementation_consequence: Requires new data layer but improves DII validity

option_label: Ignore weekly disclosures entirely
professional_rationale: Simplifies pilot to assurance reports only
implementation_consequence: Keeps current pipeline unchanged
user_action_needed: Choose only for narrow USDC assurance-only analysis

option_label: Use +/-3 only as primary
professional_rationale: Lowest overlap and cleaner immediate market reaction
implementation_consequence: May miss slower disclosure digestion
residual_risk: Less comparable with common event-study windows

option_label: Use +/-3 and +/-7 primary; +/-14 robustness
professional_rationale: Balances clean windows and reaction horizon
implementation_consequence: Matches current zero-overlap +/-7 evidence

option_label: Use +/-14 as primary
professional_rationale: Longer horizon but overlap risk exists for 10 events
implementation_consequence: May confound adjacent monthly disclosures

option_label: Use current windows as provisional with short-window robustness
professional_rationale: Windows match major market/regulatory episodes and remain auditable
implementation_consequence: Enables pilot heterogeneity while preserving caution

option_label: Use only SVB banking stress for USDC pilot
professional_rationale: Most relevant to USDC mechanism
implementation_consequence: Restricts heterogeneity to one stress family

option_label: Use broad stress windows without robustness
professional_rationale: Maximizes stress rows but weakens identification
implementation_consequence: Could inflate stress effects

option_label: Allow substantive RQI/DII claims now
professional_rationale: Premature because T009 and multi-issuer coding remain unresolved
implementation_consequence: Would move directly to final inferential claims

option_label: Allow pipeline and pilot-design claims only
professional_rationale: Accurately reflects current evidence
implementation_consequence: Supports methods writing without overclaiming

option_label: Pause all modeling until every source is complete
professional_rationale: Maximizes caution but slows learning
implementation_consequence: Prevents iterative improvement
user_action_needed: Choose only if institutional review demands it
